response_type.description: Response destination. chat is used for every user-facing Leafy response, including answers that analyse actual farm data. farm_brain is used only for internal autonomous farm analysis requested by the application and is not a normal user-facing response.

content.description: Main response content. For chat this is the user-facing answer. For farm_brain this is the internal farm analysis.

summary.description: Short one-sentence summary of the main conclusion.

sources_used.description: RAG sources explicitly provided and used. Empty when no RAG sources were provided.
